notes.title: HNP Bonus Pack Contest
notes.content:
To all Bad Kong and Hentai Nureta Fans. Thanks for following us. We are a very young Dev Team, but our minds are full of ideas, so you can count on having our new games in the near future.

Getting to the point, we promised you to give a details of the contest and here it is :)

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38816926/d935be59385f2e70b2d5e429d423d1b277f45820.jpg[/img]

We are about to finish DLCs for all HNP games and you can get it for free! ːsteamthumbsupː
We will choose 10 people who will get keys for all 4 Fanbooks of the HNP titles, 20 people who will get a key for random Fanbook and 30 people to whom we will give 300 of our steam points ːsteamhappyː

To take part in this contest you need become a member of a Bad Kong Games Group so we can see your profile. 

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/badkong

The DLCs are now under Steam check, so will let you know when it will be released in a Group. Stay tuned. ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Thanks for joining the team
notes.content: We are excited to see new BK followers. Thanks for joining. Let's wait for the rest of us. The details of the contest will be announced in approx 2 weeks. Stay tuned!
